notes.title: Small Update Nº5
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=zkIvln51O6c;full][/previewyoutube]

As you get closer to the end you'll be able to power up your Brain Ship to the maximum, it will turn purplish and will be able to resist more direct damage, multiple laser beams, more time to stop, and deadlier bombs. It's the only way to deal with all the amount of targets.

We are getting closer to full release, stay tuned for more updates of Typing Fingers.

notes.title: Small Update 4
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=rm_CW62wx14;full][/previewyoutube]

A few weeks ago we entered the last phase of development of Typing Fingers Enemy. We hope we can release a new build soon. We worked on the backgrounds of the last levels and now we are working on the last 3 bosses' combat systems.  We'll leave you a short video sneak peek with the Brain Ship with full upgrades and the new BG that players will be flying through.

notes.title: Typing Fingers Enemy - Steam Early Access Update #3
notes.notes:
One of the goals we have is giving the player the feeling of traveling in the depths of space. Because that feeling of being in outer space is one of the best experiences we can have in a space-themed game. This is how we do it.

1. To build the backgrounds, we created a shader on Unity, that has different layer (images or textures) which overlap each other but they have different speed levels.

The material allows us to custom any layer speed whichever we want to reach our desired effect. For the time being, we are working with 4 layers: the main background and 3 layers over it which give the illusion of depth.

https://64.media.tumblr.com/061677b52cb86302354fd8740cf4a13c/345984cd6efb9a92-58/s2048x3072/f8301ba12816d1efa5358bf9e4ce6fe2923b8a86.png

2. Since each layer will be moving at a different speed, we created a function that is set up to do exactly the same so we didn't need to repeat the process 4 times.

https://64.media.tumblr.com/584cd0a3904ee0fd0e428b302d0049bb/345984cd6efb9a92-4a/s2048x3072/0045f042bdd9ab183bc3efe81ece61761da7f9b3.png

3. Here is how it looks in the inspector

https://64.media.tumblr.com/bd01e525a30fdaf5a4d602e252b39da6/345984cd6efb9a92-70/s1280x1920/3e05667a6f44bc0b3c38ed7976769e08bdc097e8.png
